_comment: The tool bridge (docs/tool-bridge.md): the agents in the container drive the Firefox of your machine. Merge the Orkeon section into config/appsettings.local.json; docker mode only. On your machine, start `orkeon bridge serve` from a folder whose appsettings.json holds { "Orkeon": { "Bridge": { "Allow": ["firefox"] } } }, with the same token exported in ORKEON_BRIDGE_TOKEN on both sides (openssl rand -hex 32, 16 characters at least): a token never goes in a file. On a Linux engine keep the loopback address below: the launcher then runs the container on the host's network. Under Docker Desktop use http://host.docker.internal:7410/ and, under Windows, add "HostHeader": "localhost:7410". TokenEnvVar names another variable when ORKEON_BRIDGE_TOKEN does not suit you.
